# FeatherPanel Plugin Docs

> Complete plugin authoring documentation for humans and LLMs.
> Prefer these Markdown files (and site-wide ../llms.txt + ../catalog.json) over HTML for RAG.

Base URL: https://mythicalltd.github.io/FeatherPanel/icanhasfeatherpanel/plugins/
Repo path: frontendv2/public/icanhasfeatherpanel/plugins/

## Critical rules (summary)

1. identifier = folder; [a-zA-Z0-9_]+
2. plugin.name = PHP entry class
3. Namespace App\Addons\{identifier}\…
4. Implements App\Plugins\AppPlugin
5. Routes/*.php auto-load; Controllers do not
6. Components at /components/{identifier}/
7. Settings values are strings
8. Sidebar sections: admin|client|server|vds|webspace only
9. Addon Cron namespace: App\Addons\{id}\Cron
10. Study examples.md before inventing new patterns
